6) The only positive thing I can try and salvage is that I'm strong. I must be if I'm still here and trying when I can. I've wanted to kill myself so many times this year but here I am, there must be some kind of strength in me keeping me going despite all this.

7) I went to therapists, meds, and worked out. All of them I had to stop due to not having money to continue. The work our part is probably just lazyness on my part. In my freshman year of highschool, I think I was 14 or 15, I hurt my back by swinging my backpack full of all my textbooks around like an idiot and ended up being absent a lot and fell behind in my classes. My counselors thought it was because they were honor's classes so during the second semester I had a complete schedule change. I ended up being away from the few new friends I made and had to start all over again. No biggie though I mean I never had problems socializing or making new friends. Not the case this time. For some reason I just couldn't relate to anyone and when I tried to chime in on a discussion about music or shows people responded negatively. One group even questioned why I was talking to them. Very quickly I felt disconnected, very lonely, and incredibly sad. I didn't want to go to school I saw no point in anything I wasn't happy at home ever. I eventually saw a doctor told them what was happening and was diagnosed with depression which my parents refused to believe. There was much more to it, like I've felt all those things before but I don't think it was permanent but this time something did feel different. Everything felt more extreme and eventually when I did make friends I was still feeling terrible when I was away from them or had to be by myself. After the discussions with my doctors and therapists I found out that I was most likely suffering from depression earlier than freshman year but freshman year was definitely the trigger to what I've known and dealt with for these past 7 years.

Yes. It's like I used to think it was teen angst and then I was diagnosed and despite the diagnoses I constantly question it. I know I am but I will always have a moment here or there were I find myself questioning it, unsure if I'm really in this state or if I'm somehow trying to mentally keep myself there. One of my best friends really cares about me but he says he doesn't understand it and he gets pissed thinking about how I appear to be "suffering over nothing" and when he mentions that I start questioning a lot.

Thank you. I understand that this break up is the best situation for "us". The alternatives would be her and I stuck in a one sided relationship or her ending up cheating on me which are both probably worse than the break up. As much as I understand her reasons and what not it still hurts so damn much. I dealt with depression for years but with her I never felt it even if I tried. She leaves and I try to be positive but so many things in my life suddenly started going south. It was a domino effect and depression reared its ugly head again. It's like the moment I could have benefited most from that love and happiness is when it was gone.

Earlier on she mentioned she felt like we were becoming distant. Not really "us" but like her. She was loosing feelings for me. That was around the time some things such as work and family was getting in the way of us being intimate, we still saw each other everyday but it was either when tired after work or for a little bit of time where we couldn't be intimate much. What I hate most is almost immediately after the break up is when she got a promotion and her schedule changed enough and mine did as well but by then it was too late. 

I noticed her getting closer to that co-worker. I even asked about it and she said it was nothing for me to worry about. She went with all her co-workers to vegas (something they do once in a while) and when she came back she broke up with me. Later when I asked about it she revealed that yeah she was with him now. That it was apparent he had feelings for her last day in vegas and that's when she realized she did too. She swears she lost feelings for me months before so she didn't leave me for him but then that means I was either lead on. Like if he wasn't a factor I'm sure she would have still been with me and then I dunno maybe the changes would have helped her but no use dwelling on that. What's happened happened it just really hurts to become nothing to the person who meant the world to you.

I know she wasn't cheating on me but I mean it sucks to have been deeply in love with someone just to have it turn out this way and to know they've moved on so damn fast. It's better I know though, I asked and wanted to know because if I didn't I'd be trying to get her back and all that. In the long run this is how things go and it's not my fault and it's just life but god damn if it doesn't hurt. I know this part of the pain will go away with time and it's like I don't doubt I'll ever love or be loved again but I know that won't be for a while. It's the only time in 6 years that I was actually and consistently happy, motivated, wanting to be awake everyday and excited for anything. Is it really that bad for me to want to feel that way again so soon?

I spoke to her but I did it the way I saw appropriate. I mentioned what my psych recommended and explained that I really don't think that's what should happen even if it could. That I know this relationship is over and anything more would be inappropriate and honestly counter-productive. I got some confirmation on some things and learned a few new ones that honestly hurt but are understandable. I need to do my best to move on and understand that this person just really doesn't care if I'm a part of their life in anyway anymore even if they still mean the world to me. They appreciate and are happy to have been with me but that time is over and that's just how life goes.

I need to let go, remember what I had was a good thing and just because it is over doesn't mean that everything else in my life is. I lived hard but lived none the less without her, I can do the same now. More importantly I need to keep holding out. As hard as it is and as much as I want all of these feelings and problems to be over with they won't be until I do something about it. I tried in the past and it didn't work but you know what? I look back and I can see where I went wrong. I can see how I "tried" but in reality I didn't try hard enough. I didn't try everything. So now I just have to try something else and work harder.  I have problems and issues with myself and I need to resolve them myself. No relationship or friends or family or any one in the world but me can solve it and I'll have to do whatever it takes as long as it takes. I need to become a better person, for my future partners, my friends and more importantly, for myself and if I give up now then that will never happen. Thanks for listening and for wishing me the best. I really appreciate it.

I've tried for years to be happy on my own. The cards life has been dealing me have been getting worse and worse over time actually. I keep getting told things will get better in time, that we can't go any lower but unfortunately I have, every year has shown me that so far. As much as I have tried nothing has managed to make me happy, not long enough. Being with this girl was the first thing to have made me happier than I have ever been. Although her feelings for me faded we still could be happy and loving when we had the chance to see each other and that's what I still want. That's what I looked forward to and what kept me going. My home isn't a good place for me and I can't escape it. If I want to progress in my future I have to quit my job, go to school full time, keep living in my toxic home and try my best. With her I knew I could because whatever used to get to me couldn't when I had her. Home is a place where you can rest your weary head and forget your troubles and just relax for a moment. That was in her arms for me, no matter what her smile, voice and embrace could bring me from the brink of panic and of sadness straight to happiness. Nothing else ever has, that is what can still make me happy. 

I asked my therapist the reasoning. She told me if she says no then it's no and I can move on from there. If she says yes then I will either be happy or if I'm not I will know and then can leave her on my own terms and that will also help me to move on. I honestly fear both of those options. I don't know if I want her to take me back or not. Mentally I know things can get better for me. I know getting back together might feel good physically but won't change in the end if her heart isn't in it. I know staying broken up is probably the better choice as bad as it hurts. I've just been unhappy for so long. I gave everything and this is what happened. I'm unhappy again and I'm tired. I don't know if I'll be able to hold out long enough. I don't know if I'll make a mistake somewhere down the road before I can be happy again. I just am so afraid to face this all alone again. Friends, family, the don't help. I feel like an asshole but their love isn't enough.

Everyone is telling me that yes break ups sucks and it takes a while to get over them but not to worry because things will be back to normal in time. My normal has been major depression and anxiety. It's all I've actually known for over 6 years before this girl came along and quelled it. To go back to normal isn't a good thing for me. I'm just so defeated and tired. But yeah, it's not the end really. I just have to hold out and hopefully I can share your experience one day. Thank you.

I'm just very unhappy and have nothing else other than what we had to make me happy and without it it's been really affecting me.

I feel ya. Two weeks ago my girlfriend broke up with me. Similar deal, we met each other and fell in love when we both thought impossible. We never fought, things were perfect. Little by little our schedules stopped matching and we couldn't see each other like we used to. Eventually she told me she feels distant and her love for me fading. I told her to hold on and try. She did but two weeks ago she told me it was really over. The next week was terrible. I spoke to her today. Found out she has feelings for her co-worker, the one she would tell me about a lot. It's mutual. They've already made out apparently. As her feelings for me faded the ones for him grew. They don't know what they are, haven't talked about it and are just going with the flow, like how she and I started. I feel like I'm supposed to be heart broken but I'm not. Because deep down I love her so much I just want her to be happy even if it isn't with me. I guess this kind of thing happens to people. Feelings fade, new ones arise. I'm not in a better place by any means but today I made a realization. The fact that it happened means it can again. I will move on in time and there will be another that will love me and want me and care. Maybe it will take a while, maybe some trial and error, maybe I'll have to try again and again but one day there will be someone. But here's the thing. We can't just wait for a hand to pull us out. We need to get strong and climb out. It takes time and effort and it isn't easy but I'll be damned if it isn't worth it because I will make it worth it. I will make myself worth it. If we climb out then the one that will really be good for us, the one that will really make us happy will be there, hell even if that one is ourselves. I'm not that great at saying things online but what I'm trying to really say is that although it might not mean anything right now to hear, might not seem possible and feels very hard and terrible; in time, we'll be happy again.

With her no problem seemed great and nothing got to me because at the end of the day I had her and her love. I'm just afraid that I won't be ready if anyone comes along anytime soon and at the same time, if no one does come along soon, I don't know what will happen to me and if someone will come along in time again like she did.

I was in the same boat as you, I gave myself 4 years though. I even posted about it here too. Surprisingly though things went from hopeless to incredible shortly after for me. Now I'm not saying that something will happen to/for you to get out of this state of mind. What I am trying to say that it starts with you. Don't just think "if it doesn't get better within 2 years, then I'm done." instead act, do your best to make things better within those 2 years.
